title: CarSearchWebhookPayload
description: Payload sent from the Next.js chat API route to the n8n car-search webhook. Extended in feature 007 to include userEmail.

budgetMax.description: Maximum budget in EUR. null if the user did not specify a budget.

bodyTypes.description: Preferred vehicle body types. Use ["any"] when no preference was expressed.

fuelTypes.description: Preferred fuel types. Use ["any"] when no preference was expressed.

minSeats.description: Minimum seat count required. null if not discussed.

features.description: Features the user mentioned. Empty array if none.

yearMin.description: Minimum production year. null if not discussed.

yearMax.description: Maximum production year. null if not discussed.

engineDisplacements.description: Preferred engine displacement sizes. Use ["any"] when not discussed.

usageContext.description: Primary usage context inferred from the conversation.

annualMileage.description: Estimated annual mileage band, e.g. '10000-15000'. null if not discussed.

isRefinement.description: true if this is a follow-up refinement of a previous search.

userEmail.description: NEW (feature 007): Email address to send matched car recommendations to. If absent, null, or malformed, the email step is skipped and a non-blocking warning is recorded. Must contain '@' and a domain with at least one '.'.
